name: status-badge
title: Status Badge
description: A compact status indicator badge with icon or dot variants and semantic status colors (completed, pending, failed, disabled). Uses namespace exports: StatusBadge.Root, StatusBadge.Icon, StatusBadge.Dot.

docs.lead: A compact status indicator badge with icon or dot variants and semantic status colors.
docs.usage:
import * as StatusBadge from "@/components/ui/status-badge"

<StatusBadge.Root status="completed">
  <StatusBadge.Dot />
  Badge
</StatusBadge.Root>
